name: animation-skills
description: Six Claude Code skills that make animations for reels and film inserts (9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5; English, Russian, Hebrew; optional alpha), no footage needed: zach-d-films, stick-figure, minimalistic-graphics, map-route, breakdown and graph. Rendered on your computer with HyperFrames, three.js and Playwright.
